sentences.text:
The present application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.
520/2022, under Sections 498A/406/323/377 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Anand Vihar, Delhi.
2. Learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the parties were married for about 20 years and that the present dispute is with regard to properties.
3. Learned Senior Counsel further submits that a Memorandum of Understanding was entered into between the parties on 15.06.2022, in the presence of two independent witnesses.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file the status report.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
On the applicant joining the investigation as and when directed by the Investigating Officer, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant till the next date of hearing.
